prompt: Two seasons after Demar Derozan was traded to the San Antonio Spurs, who was the leading scorer for the fifth place team in the Western Conference?
answer: Two seasons after DeMar DeRozan was traded to the Spurs (the **2020–21 season**), the fifth-place Western Conference team was the **Portland Trail Blazers**. Their leading scorer was **Damian Lillard**, who averaged **28.8 points per game**.
